articles.title: Securitize expects to raise $400 million as tokenization firm nears public debut
articles.snippet: The BlackRock-backed tokenization specialist expects to close its SPAC merger next week and start trading on the NYSE, pending shareholder approval.

articles.title: Securitize expects to raise $400M ahead of public debut
articles.snippet: Securitize says less than 30% of shareholders in the acquisition firm taking it public elected to redeem, giving it an expected $400 million on its upcoming debut.

articles.title: US senators urge CFTC probe Polymarket over ‘deceptive marketing’
articles.snippet: Senators John Curtis and Adam Schiff are concerned about the CFTC’s enforcement ability after a “troubling” report on Polymarket’s advertising.

articles.title: SEC, CFTC seek input on unified portfolio margin rules across securities and derivatives
articles.snippet: The regulatory agencies are seeking public feedback on cross-margining, collateral and risk management as cryptocurrency derivatives and multi-asset trading continue to expand.

articles.title: Bitcoin makes first sub-$60K close since Q3 2024 as tech stocks enter ‘deep bear market’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin risked turning $60,000 into resistance as BTC price weakness persisted following another tech-driven sell-off in Asian stock markets.
